This document is a complete standalone guide for the first four weeks of the Math I
course in the first semester (Fall 2026). It was manually compiled from each relevant
source in the course-files/ folder of the course repository: weekly notes (Notes), lec-

and designated sections of the OpenStax Calculus Volume 1 textbook. Problems are
reproduced verbatim; solutions are complete, step-by-step, with verifications.
